parts.text: I work as a dispatcher at one of the drone operating companies that uses the platform's shared service. My job involves planning and running flights, which means I decide which drone flies along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can also call off a flight. Before and during a flight, things happen outside our control, and several dispatchers plan while closures can come into force even while drones of several companies are already in the air.
